description: NBA player-seasons. Given a player's season-t feature vector, predict several next-season outcomes independently — advanced efficiency stats and a raw counting line.

aggregate.headline: MTNN beats best baseline on 3/6 judged target(s) (primary metric); baseline wins the rest

summary.headline: baseline wins all 4 judged metric(s) — this domain is simple

notes.construction: y = PER of the same player in season t+1; features from season t only. Temporal split on the *target* season year: train on target-season <= cut, test strictly after. No future season is visible at fit time; a player may recur across seasons (realistic).
y = Win Shares of the same player in season t+1; features from season t. Temporal split on target season year (as PER).

summary.headline: baseline wins all 4 judged metric(s) — this domain is simple

notes.construction: y = BPM of the same player in season t+1; features from season t. Temporal split on target season year.
y = PTS/G in season t+1; features from season t. Temporal split.

summary.headline: MTNN wins 1/4 judged metric(s); baseline wins the rest

notes.construction: y = REB/G in season t+1; features from season t. Temporal split.

summary.headline: baseline wins all 4 judged metric(s) — this domain is simple

notes.construction: y = AST/G in season t+1; features from season t. Temporal split.

notes.mtnn_training: one multi-task net, 6 heads on shared 48-d embedding; trunk (128, 128), GELU, dropout 0.1; Adam lr=0.001 wd=0.0001 batch=256; seed=7; max_epochs=300 early-stop patience 25 on val (target years 2024..2025) masked MSE; best_epoch=37 best_val=0.27181; train rows: target_year <= 2023; trained in 15.5s on CPU (2 threads).
notes.baseline_data: baselines fit on the harness temporal-train side (target_year < 2026 = MTNN train + val); the MTNN never fits on val or test rows.
